## How to use

```python
import qai
import numpy as np

# Load the model (from a saved bundle)
bundle = qai.load_bundle('my_model.qmodel')
model = bundle.model

# Predict on new data
X_new = np.array([[1.0, 2.0, 3.0]])  # shape: (n_samples, n_features)
prediction = model.predict(X_new)
print(prediction)

# Get an explanation
explanation = model.explain(X_new[0])
print(explanation)
```

## Bundle / save

```python
# Save the model with logic functions + signing
qai.save_bundle(model, 'my_model.qmodel',
    logic_fns=[...],       # optional @qai.logic functions
    sign_key='my-secret',   # optional HMAC signing
    description='What this model does')

# Inspect a bundle without loading
info = qai.inspect_bundle('my_model.qmodel')

# Verify a signed bundle
valid = qai.verify_bundle('my_model.qmodel', sign_key='my-secret')
```
